---
title: "Unit Challenge"
---

## Make an observation note

Record three imaginary arrival times. Write one statement that follows directly
from them and one question the times alone cannot answer.

## Review your work

Check that your statement uses only the recorded times. Check that answering your
question would require extra information. For example, times can show who arrived
first, but cannot establish why they arrived then. Revise your note if needed.

This is ungraded practice. No submission or instructor review is required.
